responsibility: Declares the Linux target options that choose the active C library model: -mglibc, -muclibc, -mbionic, and -mmusl. These options drive the linux_libc state used by linux.h, linux-d.cc, and related specs to select dynamic linkers, builtins, include ordering, and libc capability assumptions.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-metadata file in the linux same-name group: it declares the mutually exclusive libc-selection switches (-mglibc, -muclibc, -mbionic, -mmusl), whereas linux.h uses that state to define Linux policy and linux.cc implements the libc capability helper.
